text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- All political parties in Macedonia were satisfied with the results of local elections. The political makeup of Macedonia's new local councils indicate the way the the new Parliament might look after the parliamentary elections in 1998.

- Early unofficial data says the three-party opposition coalition and the rulling Social Democratic Alliance won almost an equal number of votes in the local poll. The opposition has 295,427 votes while the Social Democrats won 275,056 votes.

- The votes of Macedonian soldiers who cast their ballots in barracks will decide who is going to be mayor in several municipalities. The electoral commission was to count their votes and declare the results later on Wednesday.
